# Root Cause Analysis

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The daily-publish `play` leg (build-mobile.yml) fails on every Android release build — `Build Android APK (god)`, `Build Android APK (store)` and `Build Android AAB` all die with `Gradle task bundleStoreRelease/assemble*Release failed with exit code 1` (runs 43560951229 on 11-14, and the 11-12/11-13 dailies).

**Root cause**: The bundled Android lint toolchain shipped with AGP 9.3.1 crashes under the JDK 17 the workflow pins. PR #2112 (commit `57c54410`, merged 2026-11-12, the Flutter 3.47.7 → 3.50.0 SDK-train migration) bumped `flutter_app/android/settings.gradle.kts` AGP 9.0.1 → 9.3.1 and the Gradle wrapper 9.1.0 → 9.5.0. AGP 9.3.1's embedded lint (IntelliJ-platform Java parser) contains code compiled against the JDK 21 API `java.util.List.removeLast()` (`SequencedCollection`, JDK 21+). Under the workflow's `setup-java` `temurin` **17**, that call throws `NoSuchMethodError: 'java.lang.Object java.util.List.removeLast()'` inside `JavaDocParser.parseDataItem`, the `CommentDetector` marks the analysis failed, and AGP fails the whole build:

```
Execution failed for task ':file_selector_android:lintVitalAnalyzeRelease'
> Unexpected failure during lint analysis of FileUtils.java
  Message: 'java.lang.Object java.util.List.removeLast()'
  The crash seems to involve the detector `com.android.tools.lint.checks.CommentDetector`.
```

`lintVital*` runs **only for release variants** — that is why the daily release lane (assembleGodRelease / assembleStoreRelease / bundleStoreRelease) reds while the PR-gate CI android leg (`flutter build apk --debug`, ci.yml) stays green: debug builds never run lintVital. The daily leg went red on 2026-11-12 — the first daily run after #2112 merged — and stayed red on 11-13 and 11-14; 11-10 and 11-11 were green on AGP 9.0.1. The nightly android row shows the identical signature (red 2026-11-14 run 43551048647; green 11-11 run 42952181313 on AGP 9.0.1) — same class break.

**Impact**: Every Android **release** build in build-mobile.yml (play leg of daily-publish) and nightly.yml (`Build android (release)` matrix row) fails; no AAB/APK reaches Play or the nightly artifacts while it lasts. Debug builds are unaffected.

**Fix approach**: Run the Android release builds on JDK 21 — the runtime lint's embedded parser requires (`List.removeLast()` resolves there). Bump `java-version: '17'` → `'21'` on the Android jobs of `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml` (build-android, submit-android, build-android-apks, test-android-emulator) and `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` (android matrix row). ci.yml's android leg stays on 17 (debug-only, proven green). No app code changes — JVM-target alignment in `flutter_app/android/build.gradle.kts` targets 17 bytecode, unaffected by the gradle runtime JDK.

**Landed work (this resumed leg)**: the fix is already on `origin/ai/gh-2176` as commit `9192193` (4 files, 182 insertions, 5 deletions: the 5 workflow JDK pins + guard test + .gitignore). This leg re-verified it on a fresh runner (see below) and re-produced the outputs.

**Verification**:
- Fresh-runner re-verification (this leg): guard `test/ci_android_release_jdk_guard_test.dart` 3/3 green on the landed tree; both edited workflow YAMLs parse; RED reproduction re-run under temurin-17 with the exact CI signature (`gradle-exit=1`), GREEN under temurin-21 (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL`, exit 0) — same tasks as the prior leg, same tree.
- Prior-leg evidence (same fix content): `:file_selector_android:lintVitalAnalyzeRelease` under temurin-17 → `BUILD FAILED`, exit 1, exact CI signature; under temurin-21 → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 58s`; `:app:lintVitalAnalyzeStoreRelease` under 21 ran all plugin-module lint tasks green; canonical `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store` under JDK 21 built the APK (covers the bumped emulator-ITs leg).
- A local bare-gradle release lint run may show `:app:compileStoreReleaseJavaWithJavac` missing `integration_test` — a dev-dependency the flutter tool strips for release builds (`FlutterPluginUtils.addFlutterDependencies`, "In release mode, dev dependencies are stripped") while regenerating the registrant; the canonical CI path (`flutter build appbundle/apk`) regenerates the registrant per build mode and never sees this.

### Root Cause

The daily-publish `play` leg red'd on every Android **release** build (APK store/god, AAB) starting 2026-11-12 — the first daily run after PR #2112 (the Flutter 3.47.7→3.50.0 train migration) bumped AGP 9.0.1→9.3.1 and Gradle 9.1.0→9.5.0. AGP 9.3.1's bundled lint embeds an IntelliJ-platform Java parser compiled against the JDK 21 API `java.util.List.removeLast()` (`SequencedCollection`); the lanes ran Gradle on temurin **JDK 17**, where the method does not exist. `CommentDetector`'s javadoc parse of `FileUtils.java` throws `NoSuchMethodError` → `:file_selector_android:lintVitalAnalyzeRelease` fails → the whole release build fails. `lintVital*` runs for release variants only — that's why the PR-gate ci.yml debug leg stayed green on the same tree.

### Fix

- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`: all four Android jobs (`build-android`, `submit-android`, `build-android-apks`, `test-android-emulator`) on `setup-java` temurin `'21'`; `.github/workflows/nightly.yml`: `build-release` android row identically (same release lint, same latent crash — red on 11-14 with the same signature).
- `flutter_app/android/.gitignore`: ignore Kotlin 2.x `.kotlin/` sessions. JVM targets stay 17 — only the Gradle runtime JDK moves.
- New guard `test/ci_android_release_jdk_guard_test.dart`: release lanes pin the AGP-derived JDK via an `agpVersionToGradleJdk` coupling map (an AGP bump fails the guard until re-derived, gh-1757 CMake-map style) + build-mobile.yml single-JDK fleet coherence. Verified failing pre-fix, passing post-fix.

### Test Coverage

- RED: local `gradle 9.5.0 :file_selector_android:lintVitalAnalyzeRelease` under temurin-17 → `BUILD FAILED`, exit 1, exact CI signature (`Unexpected failure during lint analysis of FileUtils.java`, `NoSuchMethodError … JavaDocParser.parseDataItem`); re-confirmed on the fresh runner of this resumed leg.
- GREEN: same task under temurin-21 → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 58s`; all plugin-module lint tasks green under 21; canonical `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store` under JDK 21 → `✓ Built build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-store-debug.apk` (covers the bumped emulator-ITs leg).
- Guard `test/ci_android_release_jdk_guard_test.dart`: 3/3 green on the landed tree (`9192193`); workflow-guard test subset: 313 tests green; both edited YAMLs parse.

### Notes

- ci.yml's android leg stays on 17 — debug-only, proven green, no lintVital. No app code changes; CI-toolchain-only fix. A local bare-gradle release lint run may show `:app:compileStoreReleaseJavaWithJavac` missing `integration_test` — a dev-dependency the flutter tool strips for release builds; not reachable through the canonical `flutter build` path.
